title: Positive values along a subsequence
statement: Let $(a_k)_{k\in\mathbb N}$ be a sequence of nonnegative real numbers that does not converge to $0$. Then there are $eta>0$ and a strictly increasing map $\phi:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ such that $a_{\phi(k)}\geq\eta$ for every $k$.
hypotheses_covered: The sequence $a_k$ does not converge to $0$
